description: On the tabletop there’s a blue plate on the right, a pink bowl in the back corner with a square yellow sponge-like cloth inside, and other small items like a phone, banana, and tiny figures near the middle. The left hand reaches forward and to the right into the pink bowl, pinches and lifts the yellow cloth as a left-hand object, then carries it over the blue plate and lowers it down, releasing it onto the plate while the right hand hovers nearby without touching anything.
